segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive — including several who say exfoliants normally leave them red or irritated, one with chronic hives, and a 62-year-old with "extremely sensitive" skin — mostly report no irritation and sometimes calmer skin over time, though one notes it felt slightly more drying than other Dime cleansers and switched to every-other-day use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or flaky skin, including two in very dry climates, say the beads buff away flakiness and peeling without scratching or leaving the face further dried out.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with combination skin, who also has hormonal acne, large pores and melasma, credits her Dime routine including this cleanser with clearer, more hydrated skin.
segments.mature: The reviewer who names mature, aging, thinning skin says the round beads don't scratch and the glycerin leaves her face plump rather than tight, a gentleness echoed by other reviewers in their 60s.
segments.normal: One reviewer who describes her skin as normal (and aging) reports the cleanser left her face feeling soft, with more of a soapy lather than Dime's jelly cleanser.

concerns.aging: The two reviewers who mention fine lines report improvement: one says hers gradually softened as her skin felt like it was renewing more efficiently, and the reviewer with mature, thinning skin says it softens fine lines and leaves a healthy glow without scratching.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several in dry climates, describe the cleanser as non-drying or actively hydrating, crediting glycerin and jojoba beads for a plump rather than tight finish; against this, one reviewer found it slightly more drying than Dime's other cleansers and moved to every-other-day use, and another had a dry T-zone using it twice daily before switching to once a day.
concerns.redness: Reviewers prone to redness — including one with chronic hives and one who says exfoliants usually leave her skin "very red" — consistently report no flare-up, and two describe existing redness visibly calming with continued use, with no reports of increased redness.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers use barrier language directly, saying the cleanser leaves skin "balanced instead of stripped" and does not strip the skin the way other exfoliants do, including one who expected a damaged barrier and found the opposite.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who mention blemishes report improvement — clearer skin, fewer hormonal breakouts around the chin, and better-controlled blackheads or clogged pores — but one reviewer reports acne developing along her jawline after a few uses and worsening over several days, unsure whether it was a purging phase.

extraits.texte: First impression: not a fan of the packaging, I'd love it if it were in a glass bottle which makes it more luxurious looking. Its good for traveling with but not counter top worthy. The smell is nice, reminds me of the jelly cleanser. The exfoliating part is very mild not rough, you almost can't feel it. I'd recommend this to anyone that doesnt have issues with acne since it doesnt have any acne fighting ingredients. It did make my face feel smooth but I wouldn't trade it for my every day cleanser.

The Daily Exfoliating Cleanser makes my skin feel bright and smooth. It has not dried out my skin yet I feel like it's working to reduce the appearance of my pores and smooth my skin's texture. I gave 4 stars because after a few uses I've seen acne develop along my jaw line. It was there before I started using this product but it has gotten worse over the last few days. I'm not sure if this is a situation of "getting worse before it gets better". Overall it's a good product and I look forward to continuing to use it and see how it helps my skin.

This is a great exfoliating cleanser option! My skin tends to be dry and flakey and I struggle to keep it smooth. This gave me a great base to work with before doing my makeup. I couldn't get a great picture but the texture of my skin felt smoother and after applying my makeup I didn't have any flakes built up or sticking out. The exfoliating beads were very gentle and didn't scratch my skin or cause any redness. This will be a great staple for me in my routine!

extraits.texte: I love this product! I could tell a difference in the smoothness of my skin in just two use. However, I did feel I was a tiny bit more drying than Dimes other cleansers. So I will probably use it every other day. I'm 62 years old and have extremely sensitive skin. I love all things Dime!

I've been using the **DIME Daily Exfoliating Cleanser** every single day for over a month, and I absolutely love it. I have extremely sensitive and reactive skin, so I was honestly afraid to use a physical exfoliating cleanser. I expected irritation, redness, or a damaged skin barrier. Instead, this cleanser did the exact opposite. After every wash, my skin felt calm, soft, and comfortable—never red, tight, or dry. In fact, over time it actually improved my redness. After just a few weeks, I noticed my skin looked much clearer, my pores appeared less noticeable, and my overall texture became much smoother and more even. Fine lines that usually show up when my skin isn't renewing properly gradually disappeared, and my skin looked healthier and more refreshed. It really felt like my skin was renewing itself more efficiently. What impressed me the most is how gentle the ingredients are. The exfoliation is mild enough for sensitive skin, yet the results are very noticeable. It's soothing, hydrating, and leaves my skin feeling balanced instead of stripped. I honestly don't see myself using another cleanser after this one. I also have to admit that I used to believe a cleanser couldn't make much of a difference because it's only on your skin for a minute or two before you rinse it off. This product completely changed my mind. I was wrong. Sometimes a well-formulated cleanser really can transform your skin.

This exfoliating cleanser is extremely gentle for your skin barrier and perfect for daily use! I used this cleanser after Dime's oil cleanser to double cleanse. After two days of use, my skin has not felt rough or dry afterward like some exfoliators can cause. I noticed that this cleanser left my skin feeling clean and gently exfoliated but still hydrated. I have combination skin with hormonal acne, large pores, and melasma and I have found Dime products have really helped my skin be more clear and hydrated. I will definitely continue using this exfoliating cleanser in my routine.

Perfectly gentle for mature skin! Finding a daily exfoliant for aging skin is tough, but this one is perfect. The jojoba beads are completely round and soft, so they never scratch my thinning skin. Because it is packed with glycerin, my face feels plump and hydrated after rinsing rather than tight or dry. It gently buffs away dullness, softens my fine lines, and leaves a healthy, youthful glow.
